Technical support and representation for GST scrutiny, notices, audits, assessments and appeals, grounded in records and reconciliations.

Scope of services

01Drafting replies to GST notices and intimations, including ASMT-10 and DRC-01
02Representation during assessments, appeals and departmental audits
03Input Tax Credit reconciliations and discrepancy resolution
04Review of returns, books, e-invoices and supporting records
05Advisory on GST classification, exemption and valuation issues
06Quantification of tax, interest and exposure for dispute strategy
07Preparation of written submissions and documentary evidence
08Follow-through on orders, rectification and appeal requirements

Our approach

We begin with the notice, transaction trail and return data, then build a documented position aligned with the applicable law and procedural stage. Advice is tailored to the facts and available records.

Regulatory references are current to October 2026 and may change through legislation, rules, notifications or portal updates. Applicability depends on the facts and should be confirmed for each engagement.

Can this service be combined with accounting or audit support?

Yes. The firm can coordinate related accounting, tax, assurance and advisory work, subject to applicable independence and professional requirements.
